title: Rodriguez paper proposing to test DMT entities with prime factorization

tellings.quote: back in the early 2000s, uh a guy called Rodriguez published this paper

plain: In the early 2000s a man named Rodriguez is said to have published a paper proposing a test for the beings people report meeting on DMT, a strong psychedelic drug: ask them to break a large number into its prime factors, a sum too hard for a person to do in their head. The neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore describes the paper to Michels without giving its title or where it appeared. If the beings could answer, it would suggest they are more than the user's own mind.
